description: Resource pack zip built from synthetic projects (files + base64 binaries, plus the module images their kinds ask for). The editor's builder (assembleServerPack) is the source: `cd editor && npm run pack -- vectors --write` recomputes entries, entryHashes, font counts and sha1 from the inputs. Any other builder (the hub's Kotlin one) must produce the same bytes. First generated by the former backend builder (v2 at ccade092).

cases.name: bedrock menus: backgrounds, glyphs, text fields, image buttons and states, themed folder, HD chest (hidden inventory: drawn without vanilla texture and nothing in the inventory, else skipped)

files.menus/shop.yaml:
size: 54
vanilla_texture: false
title:
  - kind: background
    asset: frame
  - kind: text
    value: "Hello {player.name}"
    x: 20
    y: 30
    color: gold
    size: 16
  - kind: glyph
    asset: coin
    x: 100
    y: 40
  - kind: glyph
    asset: coin
    x: 150
    y: -20
  - kind: textarea
    value: "<#33ccff>lines of text"
    x: 88
    y: 60
    width: 81
    alignment: center
  - kind: textarea
    value: "right"
    x: 170
    y: 70
    alignment: right
  - "<red>A plain title"
elements:
  - id: buy
    positions: "30-32"
    image: { asset: buy, fit: stretch }
    states:
      - if: [{ type: has_permission, perm: vip }]
        title: VIP
      - if: [{ type: has_permission, perm: gold }]
        image: { asset: gold, fit: contain, offset_x: 1 }
  - id: native
    positions: "0,1,9,10"
    image: { asset: gold, fit: native, offset_y: -2 }
  - id: ghost
    positions: "5"
    image: { asset: missing }
  - id: list
    positions: "0-8"
    iterates: { source: items, alias: it }
    image: { asset: buy }
  - id: bad
    positions: "40,42"
    image: { asset: buy }
